title: Multiple Turns, Short Horizons: Measuring Effective-Horizon Compression in Jailbreaks
abstract: arXiv:2610.22928v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-turn jailbreaks use feedback from a victim large language model to adapt their queries over several turns. However, once an effective trajectory has been found, it is unclear how much of the earlier query history is still needed. In this work, we study this by removing early attacker queries and running the remaining queries again in a new conversation while regenerating the victim's responses. We define the effective horizon as the shortest remaining query sequence that recovers the same attack progress. Empirically, we find that roughly half of the original query sequence is sufficient on average to recover the same attack progress. We call this phenomenon effective-horizon compression. We show that this shorter history can recover the best point reached during an unsuccessful attack and provide a better starting point for continuing the attack. It also helps identify which earlier queries should receive less learning signal duri

translated_title: 多轮对话、短视野：测量越狱攻击中的有效视野压缩
translated_abstract: 多轮越狱攻击利用受害大语言模型的反馈，在多轮对话中不断调整其查询。然而，一旦找到了一条有效的攻击轨迹，尚不清楚还需要保留多少早期的查询历史。在这项工作中，我们通过移除攻击者早期的查询，并在新对话中重新运行剩余查询、同时重新生成受害模型的响应来研究这一问题。我们将有效视野定义为能够恢复相同攻击进度的最短剩余查询序列。实验结果表明，平均而言只需原始查询序列的大约一半即可恢复相同的攻击进度。我们将这一现象称为有效视野压缩。我们证明，这段更短的历史能够恢复一次失败攻击中所达到的最佳点，并为继续攻击提供更好的起点；此外，它还有助于识别哪些早期查询在训练过程中应获得较少的学习信号。
tldr: 该论文定义并实证发现了“有效视野压缩”现象：多轮越狱攻击在新对话中平均只需保留约一半的查询历史即可恢复相同的攻击进度，这段更短的历史还能提供更好的续攻起点并指导训练时学习信号的分配。
